2609.06155.title: ExpertLens: Visualizing Embedding Spaces for Post-Hoc Explainability in MoE Enhanced Retrievers
2609.06155.paper_summary: Neural models, including dense retrievers, have been widely adopted in Information Retrieval (IR), often delivering state-of-the-art performance. Despite their effectiveness, these models operate as black boxes, limiting the interpretability of their ranking decisions. Existing post-hoc explainability methods for neural rankers primarily focus on feature-level attributions, which can be insufficient to capture the complexity of learned embedding spaces. In this work, we propose ExpertLens, a post-hoc explainability framework for Mixture-of-Experts (MoE)-enhanced dense retrievers that shifts focus from local scalar feature importance to representation-level global interpretability. ExpertLens leverages discriminative embedding space visualizations jointly with automatically extracted Concept Activation Vectors to reveal how expert routing drives embedding space formulation and retrieval effectiveness. Experiments across five IR benchmarks and two MoE-enhanced dense retrievers show that expert routing consistently improves embedding space structure, positioning queries and their relevant documents into better-defined geometric neighborhoods. Analysis of expert subspaces further reveals general-purpose dominant experts, along with minority experts exhibiting distinct linguistic specialization, with subspaces arranged according to multi-semantic concept similarity. Our code is publicly available.
2609.06155.paper_summary_zh: 神經模型，包括密集檢索器，已廣泛應用於資訊檢索（IR），通常能提供最先進的性能。儘管它們有效，但這些模型運作如同黑箱，限制了其排名決策的可解釋性。現有的事後可解釋性方法主要集中於特徵層級的歸因，這可能不足以捕捉學習到的嵌入空間的複雜性。在本研究中，我們提出了ExpertLens，一個針對混合專家（MoE）增強的密集檢索器的事後可解釋性框架，將重點從局部標量特徵重要性轉移到表示層級的全局可解釋性。ExpertLens利用判別性嵌入空間可視化，結合自動提取的概念激活向量，揭示專家路由如何驅動嵌入空間的形成和檢索效果。在五個IR基準和兩個MoE增強的密集檢索器上的實驗顯示，專家路由持續改善嵌入空間結構，將查詢及其相關文件定位到更明確的幾何鄰域中。對專家子空間的分析進一步揭示了通用主導專家，以及展現獨特語言專業化的少數專家，這些子空間根據多語義概念相似性進行排列。我們的代碼是公開可用的。
